title: Good News for WhatsApp Users on Android! 💬
body: Good News for WhatsApp Users on Android! 💬
WhatsApp has started rolling out the ability to save chat backups directly on its own servers instead of Google Drive, with 2 GB of free space and end-to-end encryption.
That means your backup stays inside WhatsApp itself.
Will you turn on automatic backup, or do you prefer doing it manually? 🔒
